symptom: `mx check` CE0126 "Missing value for parameter X" on `call java action ... ($Param = empty)` for typed (non-entity, non-microflow) parameters
cause: Builder emitted `BasicCodeActionParameterValue.Argument: ""` instead of the literal `"empty"` keyword
insight: Capture all resolved BasicParameterType params into `resolvedBasicParams`; when bound to MDL `empty`, emit `Argument: "empty"` so Studio Pro recognises an explicit empty literal rather than treating the slot as missing
